tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are having a scheduling conflict with your chemistry laboratory. There are many laboratory sessions, but the one you are assigned to meets on Wednesday afternoons. Unfortunately, your favorite student club's weekly meeting is also on Wednesdays. You need to ask your chemistry professor, Dr. Nguyen, for a schedule change. Write an email to Dr. Nguyen.
bullets: Explain the scheduling conflict you are having.
Explain why your student club meetings are so important to you.
Request a schedule change for your chemistry laboratory session.
tasks.subject: Request for chemistry laboratory change
